cases.name: Cortney Grace Henry
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Cortney was beautiful inside and out, with a heart of gold, and a spirit that shined bright. Her laugh was contagious, when she laughed we all laughed. She was the life of any event, a shoulder for everyone’s tears. Cortney was a wonderful mother, daughter, and sister who was loved by all and will be dearly missed."

cases.name: Bethany Ann Ball Israel
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "Bethany was not only a cherished wife, daughter, sister, and an expectant mother but also a beloved figure in the volleyball community.
Bethany’s radiant spirit and unwavering kindness touched the lives of all who had the privilege of knowing her. Her love for life, her family, and the friendships she nurtured are the legacies she leaves behind."

cases.narrative:
On 5/23/2024, her family members found her dismembered body during a welfare check after they did not hear from her after she went to dinner with her brother, Jack. Officers who responded to the home found several bloody weapons and tools, along with dismembered body parts believed to be Israel’s, according to a criminal complaint.

As police were searching for Ball, a 911 caller from Rosemont reported they saw a man on their front door camera placing what appeared to be a body part on their porch. Responding officers found the body part, along with Ball’s car parked nearby.

Officers found Ball covered in blood in the backyard of a neighboring home and took him into custody. He was suffering from what appeared to be a self-inflicted wound to his throat.
